files.title: On the Legalization and Decriminalization of Psychedelic Substances in the United States
files.summary: Psychedelic substances have the possiblity of treating mental conditions without the risks associated with Amphetamines. By legalizing psychedelics for medical use, it opens a whole new market for effective treatment for those who are in need. This brief paper satisfies English II of university on argumentative writing and proposals.
